comparison.objective: Replace a dusty wall-mounted AC mesh filter and close the hinged cover.
comparison.physical_skill: Large thin-part unhooking, re-hooking, bimanual alignment, and cover operation.
comparison.success_condition: Clean filter must sit on the ledge within 2 mm, behind lugs and lip, within 3 degrees and 10 mm centering; cover closes within 3 degrees for one second.
comparison.reason: Tests large-panel replacement and multi-feature seating, not small coaxial tooling, impact fracture, or loose-fragment recovery.
